column3: “flowers” renders “blossoms,” and “of one piece with it” renders “from it.”
NASB supplies “first,” “second,” and “third pair” where the Hebrew repeats “under two of the branches from it.”
“of one piece with it” renders “from it.”
“they shall mount” renders the impersonal “one shall lift up,” and “the space in front of it” renders “the side of its face.”
“which was shown to you” renders “which you are being shown.”
